summary: NPC 行为树与效用 AI 的引擎无关实现：黑板、响应式组合节点、装饰器和响应曲线打分，解决敌人丢失视野后仍追、每帧重启动作、在选项间来回摇摆。 Engine-neutral behavior tree and utility AI code for NPCs in any language: Blackboard, reactive composites, decorators and response-curve scoring. Use when an enemy keeps chasing after losing sight, restarts its action every frame or flip-flops between choices. Not for FSMs, steering or pathfinding (`game-ai`) or Unreal BT, EQS and StateTree (`unreal-behavior-trees`).
strategy: 先按前置条件安装并通读 skill ai-behavior-trees-utility-ai，规则、数字和检查以它为准；其他游戏开发 skill 不要预装。
Use when an enemy keeps chasing after losing sight, restarts its action every frame or flip-flops between choices.
Workflow: Read what exists; Pick the default shape: BT outside, utility inside; Design the Blackboard first; Choose memory or reactive per composite.
需求超出本 skill 时只换装对应的一个，命令 evolver skill fetch --asset <Gene> --out .agents --write：game-ai 用 gene_gdsk_game_ai_v1；其余查速查卡 gene_gdsk_index_v1。
